name: per_token_group_quant_int8
description: Symmetric int8 quantization per group along the flattened last dimension. x is reshaped to [num_groups,group_size]; for each group amax=max(abs(x)).clamp_min(1e-10), scale=amax/127, q=clamp(x/scale,-128,127).to(dtype). Returns q with x's shape and scales float32 with shape x.shape[:-1]+(x.shape[-1]//group_size,). group_size must divide the last dimension; dtype defaults to torch.int8. Current tests exercise bfloat16 inputs with group_size 64/128 and widths up to 8192; outputs are newly allocated.
